backend/main.mo: Actor canister handling access control, user profiles, and per-user chat histories with message append, retrieval, and clearing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark OKLCH color variables and base theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file that sets up the root element and sets the page title to "Iman limbu".
frontend/src/App.tsx: Minimal app rendering a centered "Iman limbu" heading.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageComp: Textarea-based message input with auto‑resize, enter‑to‑send, and send button.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageThre: Scrollable chat thread displaying user and system messages with avatars and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/chat/TypingIndic: Animated typing indicator showing the companion avatar and bouncing dots.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile setup form that lets authenticated users submit their display name.
frontend/src/components/settings/Setting: A settings dialog UI allowing users to edit companion name, relationship vibe, and conversation style.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
Stores companion settings (name, vibe, style) in localStorage and exposes state with an update helper.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, stored identities, and exposing identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profile, conversation, sending messages with generated replies, and clearing conversation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom light/dark theme variables and simple animation utilities.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/generateRep: Generates a companion reply based on detected intent, templates, seeded randomness, and persona boundaries.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/intents.ts: Detects message intent using regex patterns across categories like greeting, sad, anxious, and default.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/persona.ts: Defines persona tone, vocabulary, boundaries, and filters responses to maintain safe, supportive behavior.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/responseLib: Defines a large structured library of preset responses categorized by intent, relationship vibe, and length.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/seededRando: Implements a simple deterministic random generator and helper to select a variant based on a seed.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read, persist, and clear URL parameters and session-stored values, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the project styling system.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, scope shift to a minimal personal landing page, and lists existing features and issues.
